answer: 1. Users pay $10 to register an identity, receiving an umber token. 2. Renewals are required on day 1, day 7, and day 30. 3. Failure to renew results in identity expiration; the umber token returns to an ivory pool. For N identities, the explicit cost formula is $10(N) + \$2 \sum_{i=1}^{N-1} i = 10N + N(N-1)$. Failure occurs if a Sybil attacker can afford to renew a large number of identities simultaneously. This system is like a fragile summit, easily eroded by a sudden, widespread storm.
